name: ArenaKit - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: Join entry for a kit duelists may use in the arena's kit modes (the arena's Eligible kits step).

steps.description: A kit for the fixed-kit and kit-choice modes. Drag the entries to order them; the first is the default pick in kit choice.

fields.label: Kit
fields.description: The kit is loaned for the match and taken back afterwards; its own cost, cooldown and access rules don't apply in the arena.
